title: Free coordinates of a restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and assign to each of the $n$ coordinates one of three statuses: free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. The free-coordinate set consists of precisely those coordinates assigned the free status.
hypotheses_covered: a restriction status is assigned to every coordinate
